span.div:
Failure sequence:
1. Database replication (Postgres) lagged by 8 hours
2. DBA attempted to restore from backup
3. NFS mount became read-write on multiple nodes
4. Both NFS clients wrote to same files
independently
5. File metadata and content diverged
6. Restoration script deleted the NFS-backed
database directory
7. Backup restoration failed
8. 3,247 code review discussions permanently lost

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Root cause: NFS does not provide fencing.
Multiple nodes can write to the same file.
No mechanism to prevent concurrent writes.
